description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface for interacting with order-related endpoints of a backend service in an online shopping platform. It includes methods for creating orders, retrieving order details, listing orders with pagination and filtering, and performing status transitions such as pay, ship, deliver, or cancel.

classes.name: OrderApi
classes.description: Retrofit interface for order-related backend endpoints, providing methods to create, retrieve, list, and update order status.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order using the provided OrderCreateRequestDto object. Returns the created OrderDto.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID. Returns an OrderDto.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders with optional filters such as status, email, and date range.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Transitions the specified order to a paid state.

methods.name: markShipped
methods.description: Transitions the specified order to a shipped state.

methods.name: markDelivered
methods.description: Transitions the specified order to a delivered state.
